s0301.literal: Those who could expose such matters were to be given the offender's wife and children, and also rewarded with paper currency.
s0301.idiomatic: Those who exposed such matters were to receive the offender's wife and children and also be rewarded with paper currency.

s0302.literal: He also said: "During Ahmad's monopoly of power, government offices were excessively numerous, wasting salaries in vain; it would be best to merge and reduce them according to what Liu Bingzhong and Xu Heng had established."
s0302.idiomatic: He also said, "During Ahmad's monopoly of power, government offices were excessively numerous and salaries were wasted; it would be best to merge and reduce them according to what Liu Bingzhong and Xu Heng had established."

s0305.literal: An edict ordered that all matters be taken to the provincial offices for petition; where judgment was deemed unfair, one was permitted to go to the Petition Drum Court and beat the drum to make it known.
s0305.idiomatic: An edict ordered that all matters be taken to the provincial offices for petition; where judgment was deemed unfair, one was permitted to go to the Petition Drum Court and beat the drum to be heard.

s0306.literal: To prepare grain for the Japan expedition, Goryeo was ordered to supply two hundred thousand shi.
s0306.idiomatic: To prepare grain for the Japan expedition, Goryeo was ordered to supply 200,000 shi.

s0307.literal: Atahai was retained as chief minister of the Eastern Expedition Branch Secretariat.
s0307.idiomatic: Atahai was retained as chief minister of the Eastern Expedition Branch Secretariat.

s0308.literal: On bingyin day twenty thousand troops of the Five Guards were dispatched on the Japan expedition.
s0308.idiomatic: On bingyin day 20,000 troops of the Five Guards were dispatched on the Japan expedition.

s0309.literal: Three thousand ingots of notes were issued to buy grain at Chaghan Na'ur for military artisans.
s0309.idiomatic: Three thousand ingots of notes were issued to buy grain at Chaghan Na'ur for military artisans.

s0310.literal: Because Yannan, Hebei, and Shandong prefectures had suffered drought the previous year, land tax grain owed by the people was temporarily suspended; an instruction also stated: "From now on, among local officials, any who fail to report disasters and injuries in time, or among surveillance commissions who do not immediately go to inspect — all shall be punished."
s0310.idiomatic: Because Yannan, Hebei, and Shandong prefectures had suffered drought the previous year, land tax grain owed by the people was temporarily suspended; an instruction also stated, "From now on, local officials who fail to report disasters in time, and surveillance commissions that do not immediately inspect, shall all be punished."

s0311.literal: Minister of Justice Cui Yu spoke on eighteen matters of current policy; an edict ordered the Central Secretariat and censor-in-chief Yusutemur to discuss and carry them out.
s0311.idiomatic: Minister of Justice Cui Yu spoke on eighteen matters of current policy; an edict ordered the Central Secretariat and censor-in-chief Yusutemur to discuss and carry them out.

s0312.literal: The Shangdu exchange treasury was abolished.
s0312.idiomatic: The Shangdu exchange treasury was abolished.

s0313.literal: On dingmao day Boyao'dai and others cut ship timber at Lieguodu Mountain and Gan Mountain, totaling more than one hundred forty-two thousand, and five thousand attached-household troops of age and three thousand labor conscripts were mobilized to transport it.
s0313.idiomatic: On dingmao day Boyao'dai and others cut ship timber at Lieguodu Mountain and Gan Mountain, totaling more than 142,000 units, and 5,000 attached-household troops of age and 3,000 labor conscripts were mobilized to transport it.

s0314.literal: On jisi day the moon transgressed the Maid of the Charioteer in the Charioteer.
s0314.idiomatic: On jisi day the moon transgressed the Maid of the Charioteer in the Charioteer.

s0315.literal: The princes Yeligan, Tanahe, and Numuqi were each granted fifty taels of gold and one gold-lined coat.
s0315.idiomatic: The princes Yeligan, Tanahe, and Numuqi were each granted fifty taels of gold and one gold-lined coat.

s0316.literal: On gengwu day, because building ships at Pingluan required transporting timber from afar and exhausted the people with corvée labor, shipbuilding was moved to the Yang River.
s0316.idiomatic: On gengwu day, because building ships at Pingluan required transporting timber from afar and exhausted the people with corvée labor, shipbuilding was moved to the Yang River.

s0317.literal: On renshen day the Censorate said: "Yannan, Shandong, and Hebei suffered drought disaster last year; the surveillance commissions have already inspected, yet the Central Secretariat did not memorialize for exemption — how can the people bear it?
s0317.idiomatic: On renshen day the Censorate said, "Yannan, Shandong, and Hebei suffered drought disaster last year; the surveillance commissions have already inspected, yet the Central Secretariat did not memorialize for exemption — how can the people bear it?

s0318.literal: We request a temporary suspension of tax grain."
s0318.idiomatic: We request a temporary suspension of tax grain."

s0320.literal: The Gongchang Surveillance Commission was moved to administer Ganzhou.
s0320.idiomatic: The Gongchang Surveillance Commission was moved to administer Ganzhou.

s0321.literal: Right vice chancellor Jelitemur, thirty-five wanhu, two thousand Mongol troops trained as naval forces, ten thousand tamma chi, and five hundred trained in water warfare were ordered on the Japan expedition.
s0321.idiomatic: Right vice chancellor Jelitemur, thirty-five wanhu, 2,000 Mongol troops trained as naval forces, 10,000 tamma chi, and 500 trained in water warfare were ordered on the Japan expedition.

s0322.literal: On dingchou day pacification commissioner Yang Tingbi was made pacification commissioner, granted bow, arrows, saddle, and bridle, and sent to instruct the lands of Zhulan and others.
s0322.idiomatic: On dingchou day pacification commissioner Yang Tingbi was made pacification commissioner, granted bow, arrows, saddle, and bridle, and sent to instruct the lands of Zhulan and others.

s0323.literal: On jimao day all armies were ordered to practice boats and oars; eight thousand ingots of notes were granted at Longxing, Xunde, and other places for coordinated grain purchases to sustain them.
s0323.idiomatic: On jimao day all armies were ordered to practice boats and oars; 8,000 ingots of notes were granted at Longxing, Xunde, and other places for coordinated grain purchases to sustain them.

s0324.literal: On gengchen day the moon entered the Southern Dipper.
s0324.idiomatic: On gengchen day the moon entered the Southern Dipper.

s0325.literal: On renwu day the imperial carriage hunted in the near suburbs.
s0325.idiomatic: On renwu day the imperial carriage hunted in the near suburbs.

s0326.literal: Yang Wen'an, a surrendered official of Sichuan, was made pacification commissioner of the Jingnan circuit.
s0326.idiomatic: Yang Wen'an, a surrendered official of Sichuan, was made pacification commissioner of the Jingnan circuit.

s0327.literal: The Guangdong judicial surveillance commission was renamed the Haibei-Guangdong circuit; the Guangxi surveillance commission the Guangxi-Haibei circuit; the Fujian surveillance commission the Fujian Minhai circuit; the Gongchang surveillance commission the Hexi-Longbei circuit.
s0327.idiomatic: The Guangdong judicial surveillance commission was renamed the Haibei-Guangdong circuit; the Guangxi surveillance commission the Guangxi-Haibei circuit; the Fujian surveillance commission the Fujian Minhai circuit; the Gongchang surveillance commission the Hexi-Longbei circuit.

s0328.literal: On guiwei day four thousand households of Hulan and Talbuhan and others were assigned to the crown prince's appanage.
s0328.idiomatic: On guiwei day 4,000 households of Hulan and Talbuhan and others were assigned to the crown prince's appanage.

s0329.literal: On renxu day an edict ordered that six hundred oxen be lent from wealthy households such as Tuliutu to supply the poor of Qiligusi.
s0329.idiomatic: On renxu day an edict ordered that 600 oxen be lent from wealthy households such as Tuliutu to supply the poor of Qiligusi.

s0330.literal: Second month, wuzi day: garrison troops of the Two Guang and Sichuan were fixed to rotate every two or three years; their families were given rations, and officers salaries to maintain them.
s0330.idiomatic: Second month, wuzi day: garrison troops of the Two Guang and Sichuan were fixed to rotate every two or three years; their families were given rations, and officers salaries to maintain them.

s0331.literal: King Wani of Zhulan was granted a gold tally.
s0331.idiomatic: King Wani of Zhulan was granted a gold tally.

s0332.literal: The imperial son-in-law Atu was granted one thousand Jiangnan commoner households.
s0332.idiomatic: The imperial son-in-law Atu was granted 1,000 Jiangnan commoner households.

s0333.literal: On the wuxu days of the second month of spring and autumn, sacrifices were made to the soil-and-grain altars and Lord Wucheng.
s0333.idiomatic: On the wuxu days of the second month of spring and autumn, sacrifices were made to the soil-and-grain altars and Lord Wucheng.

s0334.literal: On gengyin day the moon occulted the Pleiades.
s0334.idiomatic: On gengyin day the moon occulted the Pleiades.

s0335.literal: On guisi day an edict ordered that otok money remain as before.
s0335.idiomatic: On guisi day an edict ordered that otok money remain as before.

s0336.literal: On dingyou day padded battle coats were issued to the garrison-farming troops of Bie Shibali.
s0336.idiomatic: On dingyou day padded battle coats were issued to the garrison-farming troops of Bie Shibali.

s0337.literal: On gengzi day an edict ordered that among lands occupied by powerful nobles, beyond what was allotted to each household, the remainder was all to be given to keshik retainers and others for cultivation.
s0337.idiomatic: On gengzi day an edict ordered that among lands occupied by powerful nobles, beyond what was allotted to each household, the remainder was all to be given to keshik retainers and others for cultivation.

s0338.literal: Sichuan government offices were reduced, including the Eastern, Western, and Northern Western Sichuan pacification commissions, the Tongchuan and other route garrison wanhu headquarters, the new army commander-in-chief offices, and fourteen pacification commissions of Wei, Guan, Mao, and other prefectures.
s0338.idiomatic: Sichuan government offices were reduced, including the Eastern, Western, and Northern Western Sichuan pacification commissions, the Tongchuan and other route garrison wanhu headquarters, the new army commander-in-chief offices, and fourteen pacification commissions of Wei, Guan, Mao, and other prefectures.

s0339.literal: That night Venus transgressed the Pleiades.
s0339.idiomatic: That night Venus transgressed the Pleiades.

s0340.literal: On xinchou day regulations for selecting military officers were fixed, and a law on official corruption was established.
s0340.idiomatic: On xinchou day regulations for selecting military officers were fixed, and a law on official corruption was established.

s0341.literal: On renyin day Venus transgressed the Pleiades.
s0341.idiomatic: On renyin day Venus transgressed the Pleiades.

s0342.literal: On yisi day the Longxing branch secretariat was ordered to dispatch troops to escort Champa grain ships.
s0342.idiomatic: On yisi day the Longxing branch secretariat was ordered to dispatch troops to escort Champa grain ships.

s0344.literal: On dingwei day the chieftain of Ding'an Cave sent his brothers to court; an edict granted relay horses.
s0344.idiomatic: On dingwei day the chieftain of Ding'an Cave sent his brothers to court; an edict granted relay horses.

s0345.literal: On jiyou day the rank of the Lan-yi Supervisor was raised to Grade 5A.
s0345.idiomatic: On jiyou day the rank of the Lan-yi Supervisor was raised to Grade 5A.

s0346.literal: On guichou day the Central Secretariat was instructed: "Report major matters; handle minor ones at discretion — do not cause delay."
s0346.idiomatic: On guichou day the Central Secretariat was instructed, "Report major matters; handle minor ones at discretion — do not cause delay."

s0347.literal: On jiayin day the Imperial Medical Academy was reduced to the Directorate of Imperial Physicians, given a copper seal instead, and official medical supervisory offices were established in Jiangnan and elsewhere.
s0347.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Imperial Medical Academy was reduced to the Directorate of Imperial Physicians, given a copper seal instead, and official medical supervisory offices were established in Jiangnan and elsewhere.

s0348.literal: Japan expedition officers Baghutai and soldiers were granted silver notes in varying amounts.
s0348.idiomatic: Japan expedition officers Baghutai and soldiers were granted silver notes in varying amounts.

s0349.literal: An edict dispatched officials to review prisoners at Yangzhou.
s0349.idiomatic: An edict dispatched officials to review prisoners at Yangzhou.

s0350.literal: Third month, dingsi day: three princely household officials were established for Prince Senaghe'er.
s0350.idiomatic: Third month, dingsi day: three princely household officials were established for Prince Senaghe'er.

s0351.literal: Wanhu Buduman was ordered to garrison Jingchi.
s0351.idiomatic: Wanhu Buduman was ordered to garrison Jingchi.

s0352.literal: Jurchen shipbuilding for the Japan expedition was halted; the Hexi Branch Censorate was abolished; a branch Works Ministry was established at Gongchang and elsewhere.
s0352.idiomatic: Jurchen shipbuilding for the Japan expedition was halted; the Hexi Branch Censorate was abolished; a branch Works Ministry was established at Gongchang and elsewhere.

s0353.literal: The Fujian maritime trade commissioner-in-chief office was abolished, retaining only the supervisory office; the Quanzhou branch secretariat was merged into the Fujian branch secretariat; and uncollected seedling tax since Fujian's submission was remitted.
s0353.idiomatic: The Fujian maritime trade commissioner-in-chief office was abolished, retaining only the supervisory office; the Quanzhou branch secretariat was merged into the Fujian branch secretariat; and uncollected seedling tax since Fujian's submission was remitted.

s0354.literal: Kuokuonitudun was put in charge of the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat; when faults were reported against him, Unuhudai and Bayan were ordered to assist him.
s0354.idiomatic: Kuokuonitudun was put in charge of the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat; when faults were reported against him, Unuhudai and Bayan were ordered to assist him.

s0355.literal: On wuwu day a newly submitted cave Miao chieftain was made qianhu.
s0355.idiomatic: On wuwu day a newly submitted cave Miao chieftain was made qianhu.

s0356.literal: On jiwei day Jupiter transgressed Jianbi.
s0356.idiomatic: On jiwei day Jupiter transgressed Jianbi.

s0357.literal: The Jingzhao branch secretariat was abolished and a branch Works Ministry established.
s0357.idiomatic: The Jingzhao branch secretariat was abolished and a branch Works Ministry established.

s0358.literal: Censorate officials said: "Shipbuilding at Pingluan, timber-cutting on Wutai Mountain for temple construction, and building a new temple south of the city — in all forty thousand laborers are conscripted; we request these be halted."
s0358.idiomatic: Censorate officials said, "Shipbuilding at Pingluan, timber-cutting on Wutai Mountain for temple construction, and building a new temple south of the city — in all 40,000 laborers are conscripted; we request these be halted."

s0359.literal: The edict said: "Timber-cutting for temples is to cease immediately; on shipbuilding, discuss with provincial officials."
s0359.idiomatic: The edict said, "Timber-cutting for temples is to cease immediately; on shipbuilding, discuss with provincial officials."

s0360.literal: Among front and rear guard troops who volunteered for Japan, more than one thousand Han soldiers of the Five Guards were selected to remain; all newly submitted troops were ordered to go.
s0360.idiomatic: Among front and rear guard troops who volunteered for Japan, more than 1,000 Han soldiers of the Five Guards were selected to remain; all newly submitted troops were ordered to go.

s0361.literal: On gengshen day the moon transgressed the Well.
s0361.idiomatic: On gengshen day the moon transgressed the Well.

s0362.literal: On xinyou day battle merit of troops under Prince Heban's younger brother Mangudai was rewarded with silver notes, silks, and clothing in varying amounts.
s0362.idiomatic: On xinyou day battle merit of troops under Prince Heban's younger brother Mangudai was rewarded with silver notes, silks, and clothing in varying amounts.

s0363.literal: Notes were issued to Ganzhou garrison troops.
s0363.idiomatic: Notes were issued to Ganzhou garrison troops.

s0364.literal: On renxu day the moon transgressed the Ghost.
s0364.idiomatic: On renxu day the moon transgressed the Ghost.

s0365.literal: On yichou day Unuhuludai was ordered to Yangzhou to review prisoners; heavy criminals from north of the Yangzi were banished to the Japan expedition.
s0365.idiomatic: On yichou day Unuhuludai was ordered to Yangzhou to review prisoners; heavy criminals from north of the Yangzi were banished to the Japan expedition.

s0366.literal: The Yunnan Surveillance Commission was established to audit branch secretariat documents.
s0366.idiomatic: The Yunnan Surveillance Commission was established to audit branch secretariat documents.

s0367.literal: Gold-washing offices at Huai'an and elsewhere were abolished; gold was to be levied only by household count.
s0367.idiomatic: Gold-washing offices at Huai'an and elsewhere were abolished; gold was to be levied only by household count.

s0368.literal: Ahmad's cotton silk and thread were given to impoverished artisan commoners.
s0368.idiomatic: Ahmad's cotton silk and thread were given to impoverished artisan commoners.

s0369.literal: A seal was granted to royal tutor Unaqutipch; relay horses were granted to officials taking posts in Western Sichuan, Fujian, and the Two Guang.
s0369.idiomatic: A seal was granted to royal tutor Unaqutipch; relay horses were granted to officials taking posts in Western Sichuan, Fujian, and the Two Guang.

s0370.literal: Because Hunan pacification commissioner Zhang Dingxin, branch secretariat associate administrator Fan Ji, and others had fawned on Alihaiya, they were ordered dismissed.
s0370.idiomatic: Because Hunan pacification commissioner Zhang Dingxin, branch secretariat associate administrator Fan Ji, and others had fawned on Alihaiya, they were ordered dismissed.

s0371.literal: On bingyin day the imperial carriage went to Shangdu.
s0371.idiomatic: On bingyin day the imperial carriage went to Shangdu.

s0372.literal: Jiangxi branch secretariat administrator Wanyan Nahua'i was dismissed for exceeding precedent in sudden promotion and improperly recommending one hundred ninety-eight persons for office.
s0372.idiomatic: Jiangxi branch secretariat administrator Wanyan Nahua'i was dismissed for exceeding precedent in sudden promotion and improperly recommending 198 persons for office.

s0373.literal: The Hexi revenue-collection supervisory office was abolished.
s0373.idiomatic: The Hexi revenue-collection supervisory office was abolished.

s0374.literal: On dingmao day six Mongol supervising censors were added.
s0374.idiomatic: On dingmao day six Mongol supervising censors were added.

s0375.literal: On yisi day Jupiter transgressed Fang.
s0375.idiomatic: On yisi day Jupiter transgressed Fang.

s0376.literal: On guiyou day Jupiter occulted Fang.
s0376.idiomatic: On guiyou day Jupiter occulted Fang.

s0377.literal: Lin Guifang, Zhao Liangqian, and others of Xinhui county, Guangzhou, gathered a crowd, falsely styled themselves the Luoping State, and proclaimed the Yankang reign title; government troops captured them, they were executed, and the remaining followers were all pacified.
s0377.idiomatic: Lin Guifang, Zhao Liangqian, and others of Xinhui county, Guangzhou, gathered a crowd, falsely styled themselves the Luoping State, and proclaimed the Yankang reign title; government troops captured them, they were executed, and the remaining followers were all pacified.

s0378.literal: On yihai day corvée laborers everywhere were dismissed.
s0378.idiomatic: On yihai day corvée laborers everywhere were dismissed.

s0379.literal: Atahai was dispatched to garrison Quxian; Handulu Shimi led newly submitted Ganzhou troops to Wandan.
s0379.idiomatic: Atahai was dispatched to garrison Quxian; Handulu Shimi led newly submitted Ganzhou troops to Wandan.

s0380.literal: On jimao day paper currency for horse prices was issued to guard troops on expedition.
s0380.idiomatic: On jimao day paper currency for horse prices was issued to guard troops on expedition.

s0381.literal: On xinsi day four Uighur relay stations and note exchange treasuries were established.
s0381.idiomatic: On xinsi day four Uighur relay stations and note exchange treasuries were established.

s0382.literal: On renwu day Taiyi was sacrificed to.
s0382.idiomatic: On renwu day Taiyi was sacrificed to.

s0383.literal: The Fujian circuit pacification commission was abolished; a branch secretariat was re-established at Zhangzhou; Central Secretariat right vice chancellor Zhang Hui was made grand councillor, censor-in-chief Esentemur left vice chancellor; both directed branch secretariat affairs.
s0383.idiomatic: The Fujian circuit pacification commission was abolished; a branch secretariat was re-established at Zhangzhou; Central Secretariat right vice chancellor Zhang Hui was made grand councillor and censor-in-chief Esentemur left vice chancellor; both directed branch secretariat affairs.

s0384.literal: Notes were granted to Mili Zaman and Hebasi.
s0384.idiomatic: Notes were granted to Mili Zaman and Hebasi.

s0385.literal: Relief was given to the impoverished of the Balu keshik, Balakachi, and others.
s0385.idiomatic: Relief was given to the impoverished of the Balu keshik, Balakachi, and others.

s0386.literal: Horses, cattle, and sheep were granted in varying amounts to troops under Prince Beiping.
s0386.idiomatic: Horses, cattle, and sheep were granted in varying amounts to troops under Prince Beiping.

s0387.literal: Summer, fourth month, bingxu day: a pacification commission was established at Bie Shibali, Hezhou, and elsewhere.
s0387.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, bingxu day: a pacification commission was established at Bie Shibali, Hezhou, and elsewhere.

s0388.literal: On gengyin day Yalihai was ordered to garrison and guard Yixibuxi.
s0388.idiomatic: On gengyin day Yalihai was ordered to garrison and guard Yixibuxi.

s0389.literal: Grand marshal Yesu'er returned from Yixibuxi, encamped at Chengdu, requested an audience, and was granted it; men were still dispatched to garrison strategic passes.
s0389.idiomatic: Grand marshal Yesu'er returned from Yixibuxi, encamped at Chengdu, requested an audience, and was granted it; men were still dispatched to garrison strategic passes.

s0390.literal: Twenty thousand imperial guard troops were assigned to assist the Japan expedition.
s0390.idiomatic: Twenty thousand imperial guard troops were assigned to assist the Japan expedition.

s0391.literal: On xinmao day Privy Council officials said: "Mongol imperial guard troops farming at Xincheng and elsewhere find gravel unsuitable for planting; we request reassignment to good fields."
s0391.idiomatic: On xinmao day Privy Council officials said, "Mongol imperial guard troops farming at Xincheng and elsewhere find gravel unsuitable for planting; we request reassignment to good fields."

s0393.literal: On renchen day Atahai requested naval-trained army officers for the Japan expedition; marshals Zhang Lin, pacification commissioner Zhang Xuan, and supervisor Zhu Qing and others were ordered to go.
s0393.idiomatic: On renchen day Atahai requested naval-trained army officers for the Japan expedition; marshals Zhang Lin, pacification commissioner Zhang Xuan, and supervisor Zhu Qing and others were ordered to go.

s0394.literal: The king of Goryeo was put in charge of the branch secretariat to plan Japan affairs.
s0394.idiomatic: The king of Goryeo was put in charge of the branch secretariat to plan Japan affairs.

s0395.literal: On jiawu day medical supervisory offices in Jiangnan circuits were reduced; one was kept in each of the four provinces.
s0395.idiomatic: On jiawu day medical supervisory offices in Jiangnan circuits were reduced; one was kept in each of the four provinces.

s0396.literal: Two-thirds of old tax and one-third of new tax on powerful-estate lands registered in the capital region were remitted.
s0396.idiomatic: Two-thirds of old tax and one-third of new tax on powerful-estate lands registered in the capital region were remitted.

s0397.literal: King Wang Chun of Goryeo requested that Mongols serve jointly in branch secretariat affairs.
s0397.idiomatic: King Wang Chun of Goryeo requested that Mongols serve jointly in branch secretariat affairs.

s0398.literal: Court attendants were forbidden to seek offices for others and disrupt the selection system.
s0398.idiomatic: Court attendants were forbidden to seek offices for others and disrupt the selection system.

s0399.literal: The alcohol prohibition was strictly enforced: private distillers' property and female dependents were confiscated by the state and offenders were assigned to corvée.
s0399.idiomatic: The alcohol prohibition was strictly enforced: private distillers' property and female dependents were confiscated by the state and offenders were assigned to corvée.

s0400.literal: The private salt prohibition was enforced; surveillance commissions were permitted to investigate salt offices.
s0400.idiomatic: The private salt prohibition was enforced; surveillance commissions were permitted to investigate salt offices.
